offset_contract.source_binary_byte_offset: Byte offset in the final repacked GLB BIN, not in the chunk BIN.
offset_contract.source_range: chunk_accessor selects the chunk-local accessor and its local bufferView.
offset_contract.preserved_offsets: Every assembly accessor, bufferView and BIN offset matches the byte-reassembled repacked GLB. The original source accessor storage layout changes during exact repacking.

limitations: Equality concerns the exported mesh and source identities; it does not extend native mounting, mate, clearance, movement or functional approval.
Chunking bounds individual delivery allocations. Device rendering and GPU memory have not been measured by this evidence.
